## 1️⃣ GATEKEEPER VERSION

### Problem  
- **Procurement:** The plant relied on manual safety‑walk observations (two walks per day) to monitor Personal‑Protective‑Equipment (PPE) compliance, leading to high labour cost and limited coverage of the 146 existing CCTV cameras.
